note: Prototype dataset covering every district of Assam. Prices are illustrative figures, not the live AGMARKNET feed; the live feed replaces them row by row when reachable. Distances are never stored — they are computed from coordinates, and refined to real driving distance by OSRM when the network allows. Every one of the 40 mandis now quotes all six crops; paddy figures are unchanged.
